_comment: Per-tenant deployment plans. Copy to TenantDeployments.json (git-ignored) and edit. Deploy-ToIntune.ps1 uses a tenant's plan automatically, so '.\Deploy-ToIntune.ps1 -TenantName "Contoso"' deploys exactly these apps with these assignments. Passing -AssignToAllUsers/-AssignToAllDevices/-AssignToGroupName ignores the plan. Preview with -ShowPlan, which needs no credentials. App names must match the keys in AppConfig.ps1 (case-insensitive).

Fabrikam._comment: AllUsers is assigned with intent 'available', AllDevices with 'required'. Groups take an optional Intent of 'Available' (default) or 'Required'. An empty {} deploys the app with no assignment - used for dependency-only apps such as VCRedist, which KeePassXC also pulls in automatically when it is missing.
